title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go; parity fixes; v1.117.1 bump
author: Evan Liu
description: Motivation: bring SDK parity between Python/TypeScript/Go for auth handling, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics. This consolidates previous ad-hoc differences that caused cross-language behavioral drift and customer confusion. Changes include: - Unify default auth token refresh behavior across SDKs (background refresh + singleflight suppression). - Standardize retry policy: idempotency classification, exponential backoff with jitter, and max-retries default aligned with platform policy. - Improve streaming API ergonomics: consistent chunk/frame model, proper cancellation propagation, and backpressure hints for long-lived streams. - Parity fixes and small API surface adjustments to match reference docs. - Version bumps for all SDKs to v1.117.1 and updated CHANGELOGs. Checklist: - [x] Python: implement auth background refresh + retry middleware, update tests - [x] TypeScript: align SDK class constructors and streaming events, add ergonomic helpers - [x] Go: introduce client option wrappers for unified retry/auth behavior, streaming iterator parity - [x] End-to-end live smoke tests against staging endpoints - [x] Update CHANGELOGs and release notes Notes: kept surface changes minimal; most behavior is opt-in via defaults. Migration guide in SDK README and upgrade notes in CHANGELOG. See related Linear tasks ENG-1173, ENG-1210. This description intentionally consolidates multi-language changes into one PR to ensure cross-SDK parity in a single release window and prevent rollouts of mismatched SDK versions.
